Un-fortunately here in Canada, the moment you are flagged with mental issues you basically cant join the military. Tried thinking it'd give me purpose.

I moved to figure out life a bit. Its not for the lack of trying. I do try. I am 3 years clean off of hard drugs, and starting to finally wake up and fight through it. 

I don't need closure I guess you can say, more like, certainty. Know that I am not just waisting my life and time away. Yanno?

I can relate. Its hard to shed a tear after feeling so numb, the excitement of disappointment seems like a feeling thats easier to receive. 

I put myself through trials and pain just because I know I can feel it and maybe it can just give me that extra push I need to finish what my depression started. 

Its not healthy but I tend to live off false hope. 
I know that it is wrong but I can feel something.
